_help: Training Room bridge settings. Restart the bridge after editing. roomName: room name the bridge reports to devices; port: HTTPS port for the headset/phone on your network; httpPort: plain HTTP on this laptop only (also for adb reverse); roomKey: code other devices need (delete it to get a new one); provider: "ollama" or "openai" (LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server at openaiUrl); ollamaUrl: Ollama's address; openaiUrl: the OpenAI-compatible server's address (LM Studio: http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1); openaiKey: bearer key for provider "openai" ("" for none); model: "" picks an installed model automatically (names with "coder", then "qwen"); visionModel: "" picks an installed vision model (llava, qwen2.5vl, gemma3 and others) that looks at magic-marker drawings, else the text model reads them as ASCII art; think: false turns hidden reasoning off for faster answers, true on, null leaves the model default; numCtx: model context size in tokens, 2048-262144 (lower uses less memory; the bridge shortens its prompt to fit); parserFirst: true makes devices use the built-in command parser for commands it understands and ask the model only for the rest (instant spawns on a laptop without a graphics card), false asks the model first; modelTimeoutSec/visionTimeoutSec: how long a model answer may take, 5-600 s (raise them for a slow laptop; vision is for magic-marker drawings with a vision model); sttKind: "whisper.cpp" (whisper-server at sttUrl), "openai" (an /v1/audio/transcriptions URL) or "none"; sttModel: model name sent to an "openai" transcription server; sttLanguage: language code such as "en" ("" sends none, so the server's own setting applies); sttPrompt: words that help Whisper spell commands and part names ("" turns it off); ttsKind: "none" (the headset's own browser voice), "piper" (piper1-gpl HTTP server at ttsUrl, default http://127.0.0.1:5000) or "openai" (Kokoro-FastAPI, speaches or any /v1/audio/speech URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8880/v1/audio/speech) speaks the AI's replies with a laptop voice; ttsVoice/ttsModel: voice and model for "openai"; partsDirs: extra folders with parts (blueprint .json, .glb/.gltf, .js; relative paths start in the data folder); allowOrigins: web pages allowed to call this bridge from another site. This file is an example: the bridge creates config.json in its data folder on first run (Windows: %APPDATA%\dot-training-room, elsewhere ~/.config/dot-training-room).
